tool_args.content:
% Limitations --- required by ACL/EMNLP

Our primary results are on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B~\citep{deepseek2025r1} with GQA ($G{=}7$); cross-model validation on Qwen2.5-Math-7B covers SFT recovery only ($N{=}200$), and both models share the Qwen2.5 base architecture, so generalization to different architecture families (e.g., LLaMA, Mistral) and scales (1B--70B) remains open.
Reward-accuracy decoupling at 20--25\% sparsity means that recovery capacity does not predict downstream accuracy improvements within our training horizon; practitioners seeking accuracy gains may require longer training, different reward formulations, or lower sparsity levels.
At 20\% sparsity, pruning reduces memory by ${\sim}$28\% but inference throughput decreases by 19\% (72.0$\to$58.3 tok/s), likely because channel-group pruning creates irregular patterns that current hardware cannot accelerate.
CKA-only, Standard, and Random are validated over 3 GRPO seeds while \rasp{} at $\alpha{=}1.0$ uses a single seed; Random uses a 512-token generation limit (vs.\ 1{,}024 for other methods), so its ranking should be interpreted as a conservative bound.
We evaluate on three benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH-500, MBPP) covering math reasoning and code generation; logical, commonsense, and multi-modal reasoning are not addressed.

\section{Seed Reproducibility}
\label{sec:appendix_seed}

We verify that the recovery capacity spectrum (\S\ref{sec:recovery_gradient}) is robust to GRPO random seed variation.
CKA-only GSM8K accuracy across 3 GRPO seeds: 64.37\% (seed 42), 64.22\% (seed 123), 64.59\% (seed 456), yielding mean 64.39\% $\pm$ 0.19\,pp.
Standard: mean 59.84\% $\pm$ 0.38\,pp across the same 3 seeds.
The 4.55\,pp gap between CKA-only and Standard is stable, with non-overlapping ranges across all seeds.
See Table~\ref{tab:multiseed} for the full breakdown including 15\% sparsity results.

展示某一层（如 L5）内 28 个 MLP channel group 的 pairwise CKA 相似度矩阵。用色温直观展示哪些 group 功能冗余（高 CKA，深色）、哪些功能独特（低 CKA，浅色）。这张图让读者一眼理解 $F(h)$ 在测量什么——把公式变成画面。
